name: Technical Questionnaire Summary V3
query:
Select
    ld.company_name as "Lead Name:Data:200",
    wtq.name as "WWTP TQ:Link/WWTP Technical Questionnaire:180",
    wtq.workflow_status as "WWTP TQ:Select/Status:180",
    wtq.opportunity as "Opportunity:Link/Opportunity:200",
    count(svr.name) as "Visit Request:Int:140",
    count(sv.name) as "Site Visit:Int:140",
    count(ws.name) as "Water Sample:Int:140",
    count(wtp.name) as "Technical Proposal:Int:140",
    count(cp.name) as "Customer Proposal:Int:140"
From
    `tabWWTP Technical Questionnaire` wtq 
LEFT JOIN `tabLead` ld
ON wtq.lead = ld.name
LEFT JOIN `tabSite Visit Request` svr
ON wtq.name = svr.technical_questionnaire
LEFT JOIN `tabSite Visit` sv 
On wtq.name = sv.wwtp_technical_questionnaire
LEFT JOIN `tabWater Sample` ws
On wtq.name = ws.wwtp_technical_questionnaire
LEFT JOIN `tabWWTP Technical Proposal` wtp
On wtq.name = wtp.wwtp_technical_questionnaire
LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer Proposal` cp
On  wtp.name = cp.wwtp_technical_proposal

GROUP BY wtq.name;
